thesaurus.definition: the matter ejected in vomiting
a medicine that induces nausea and vomiting
the reflex act of ejecting the contents of the stomach through the mouth

vi_block: Thuốc mửa; chất làm nôn mửa.

wiktionary.gloss: The regurgitated former contents of a stomach; vomitus.
The act of regurgitating.
The act of vomiting.
Anything that is worthless; rubbish; trash.

idioms.gloss: To vomit with great expulsive force, so that the material expelled is projected away from the source.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see vomit, blood.
Synonym of all hat and no cattle.

tatoeba.en: If you feel sick, you have to vomit?
tatoeba.vi: Nếu bạn bị cảm, bạn có nôn không?

blocks.etymology: Because gold is expensive even in small amounts.

examples: I find my dog is worth her weight in gold on those long snowy weekends when I can't get out.
